pages.title: Medical
pages.text: $(bold)DUTY LOG$()$(br)Anand, R., medical$(br2)Why I am here: somebody has to sign. I was told this post needs a doctor who can write a certificate, and that nobody would ask me to write one.

The wand has never been fired. I have nothing to do but keep the forms in order.$(br2)The certificates came pre-printed. The cause is already filled in. It says Transfer.$(br2)I asked to where. I was told that was not a medical question.
